title: Render a List from Data
prompt:
The `document` object in this challenge records what you build — use it exactly like the real one: document.createElement(tag), document.querySelector(selector), and parent.appendChild(child).

1. Select the list with id "todo-list".
2. Loop over the given `todos` array (it is provided in the boilerplate) and for each item: create an <li>, set its text to the todo, and append it to the list.

tests.name: three list items appended
tests.hint: for (const todo of todos) { const li = document.createElement("li"); li.textContent = todo; list.appendChild(li); }

tests.name: items contain the right text, in order
tests.hint: Set li.textContent = todo (the loop variable) — not a fixed string.
